notes.title: Update 1.0.5 - Controller support, new achievement and balance improvement!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35363532/e46936889440d2b29de180c166df75455371a727.png

Hi everyone! We have just updated to version 1.0.5 with some changes:

1. Now you can control the ship with controller.
Please keep in mind controller just support to control ship, not support UI interaction. We also just only tested on Xbox 360 controller for now. We'll try to improve in the next update.

2. Some boss at late mission have the same HP with version in early mission, so now we adjust their HP to make them more tough at the end.

3. We realized that many player enjoy with Hardcore mode but there are no reward for them, so we was add some new achievement to encourage player play Hardcore mode.
p/s: For player has finish hardcore mode or eligible to get achievement before this update, please try to play new playthrought or do it again to get it. Sorry for inconvenient.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 with Custom Mouse sensity, game balance and bug fixed
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have just updated to version 1.0.3.

What news:
- Added custom mouse sensitive in settings.
- Increased Power Core dropped from bosses and elite enemies.
- Increased stars dropped from some enemies.
- Reduced Elite Enemy's HP.
- Decreased all skills cooldown time.
- Increased Iron Will skill duration.
- Fixed Perfect Killing skill bug: not performing enough attacks.
- Increased Perfect Killing skill damage.
- Increased the healing amount of Super Healing skills.
- Reduced the price of Power Core.
- Reduced few enemy bullets.
- Reduced the Dralla Boss lifesteal (mission 16).
- Reduced the number of stars required to reset skills.
- Reduced the size of small projectiles of the enemy.
